category_title: Students performing as docile, self-disciplined test-takers
scenario_title: Managing environmental rigidity before an assessment
minimal_context: Bill is preparing to take the SRI assessment in the classroom while the teacher gets ready to distribute the test booklets.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, it is time to get ready for the SRI assessment. Please find a seat so I can distribute the test booklets.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walking back from using the bathroom) Someone moved their table to my spot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just find another open table for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But that is my regular testing spot. I claimed it as my own.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Any seat will work for the test. Please sit down so we can begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Can I please sit at my regular spot? I need to pull the table close to my body and sit still there.
